Wolf.notes: Pack (WIRED): +1 damage for each OTHER living pack ally its side controls. Mobile harasser; weak alone, dangerous in numbers.

Bear.notes: Bulwark (WIRED): if it does not attack this turn, it braces for +4 shield through the enemy turn. 1 AP: hit hard OR be tough. Emerges from Forest old growth.

Boar.notes: Charge (WIRED): covering 2+ tiles this turn before the hit adds +3 damage. 2 AP but 5-tile moves — a fast line-breaker that wants a running start.

Crows.notes: Flying: ignores terrain and line-of-sight blocking. Scout: reveals hidden effects/buffs on enemies in sight — echoes Hess's ally ability and her crow.
